messages.author: 3800250b32bf48a2
messages.subject: GGIR failing on part4
parts:
Hi Vincent,

I'm processing one data using the "advanced sleep log" and I'm getting the following error on part4:

_______________________________________________________________________________________
Part 4
Error in `[.data.frame`(S, , coln1 + ((i - 1) * 2)) :
  undefined columns selected
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In g.loadlog(params_sleep[["loglocation"]], coln1 = params_sleep[["coln1"]],  :
  NAs introduced by coercion
2:
None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched with the ID numbers in the sleeplog. You may want to check that the ID format in your sleeplog is consistent with the ID column in the GGIR part2 csv-report, and that arguments coldid and sleeplogidnum are correctly set. 


Please, see attached the script I'm using and the files used as input for "data_cleaning_file" and for "loglocation". I even used the option "do.sibreport=TRUE". I carefully check the ID in all the files, and they are all matching.

Let me know if you need any other information.

Best,
Nathalia

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: GGIR failing on part4
parts:
Hi Nathalia,

A couple of observations:
  • You have idloc = 1 and you are processing a ".gt3x" file. Actigraph files do not store the ID information on the header, so idloc = 1 is not meaningful and the ID would not be extracted. You may need to change that and re-run from part 2 onwards (make sure you set overwrite = TRUE when you do that). You may want to look at the documentation for the argument "idloc".
  • Then, you need to make sure your sleeplog ID match with the IDs you see in your reports from part 2 (results folder).
  • Looking at your sleeplog, your "coln1" should be 2 (not 3 as you have it in your script).
Best,
Jairo
